name: PostgresChatMemory
description: Connects to a Postgres database you manage. Create the table yourself before using this node.

fields.label: Table Name
fields.description: Name of the chat history table you created in your Postgres database. The table must have columns: `id`, `session_id`, `message` (jsonb), `created_at`.

fields.label: Context Window Length
fields.description: Number of most recent user/assistant turns loaded into the prompt (≈ 2× messages).
